admission.justification: Realized across source resolution, pinned refs, recovery and the tool registration in several files, so one statement keeps resume and cancel journal-only.

applicability: A master line synchronized from the repository default branch through worktree_sync with sync_source="repository-default".
conditions: The default source branches resolve to local tips when the sync starts.
The sync key identifies the source pair; a live default check applies only on continue.
exclusions: Synchronization from the line's own source branches (the ordinary route).
The contract's code and memory base pair, which this route leaves unchanged.
statement: worktree_sync with sync_source="repository-default" syncs a master line from the repository's default branch: it pins the default tips under the sync key's default-source refs, keeps the contract's base pair unchanged, appends one sync-log entry naming the source branches, commits and heads, resumes and cancels from the journal alone (a live default check only on continue), and cancel removes only its own entry.
